description: How bundled controller drawings are drawn, in the order Settings lists them. body and details: the colours of the drawing's dark and light areas, in Corporate Blue colours (or a theme role such as button_fill), mapped by the current theme. Without them the files keep their own colours. The kind of drawing is the code's: eye_candy outlines every shape, dark and light mix body and details by lightness. outline_width: Eye Candy's outline, as a share of the drawing's largest side. glyph_size: smaller shapes are letters and symbols, left light and unoutlined.
